Bootstrap version 4, taking sample randomly from each column.

```{r}
# random functions
clear.labels <- function(x) {
  if(is.list(x)) {
    for(i in seq_along(x)) {
      class(x[[i]]) <- setdiff(class(x[[i]]), 'labelled') 
      attr(x[[i]],"label") <- NULL
    } 
  } else {
    class(x) <- setdiff(class(x), "labelled")
    attr(x, "label") <- NULL
    
  }
  return(x)
}  
```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(names_from = shortnames, values_from = var) %>%
```

# Build up

```{r}
library(data.table)

# Create the original data frame
data <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 120, ncol = 5))
names(data) <- c("ID", "Month", "Apple", "Maize", "Bread")
data$zone <- c(rep("Central", 40), rep("Western", 30), rep("Northern", 20), rep("Southern", 30))
data$ID <- 1:120
data$Month <- sample(1:12, size = 120, replace = TRUE)
data$Apple <- data$Month + 2 * runif(12) - 1
data$Maize <- data$Month + 2 * runif(12) - 1
data$Bread <- data$Month + 2 * runif(12) - 1

# Convert to data.table for efficient manipulation
data_dt <- as.data.table(data)

data_dt %>% 
  group_by(zone, Month) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = n) %>% 
  arrange(Month)
```


```{r define first boot: spatial}
# Convert the 'Month' column to integers (if necessary)
data_dt[, Month := as.integer(Month)]

# Step 1: Upsample each month within each zone to ensure at least 10 rows
upsampled_data <- data_dt[, {
  if (.N < 3) {
    .SD[sample(.N, size = 3, replace = TRUE)]  # Upsample to 10 rows
  } else {
    .SD  # Keep original data if already 10 or more rows
  }
}, by = .(zone, Month)]

library(data.table)

# Step 1: Identify zones with missing months
all_months <- 1:12
missing_data <- data_dt[, {
  missing_months <- setdiff(all_months, unique(Month))
  list(missing_months = list(missing_months))
}, by = zone]

# Function to find the nearest previous and following months that are not missing
find_nearest_months <- function(zone_data, month) {
  available_months <- unique(zone_data$Month)
  
  # Find the nearest previous month
  prev_months <- available_months[available_months < month]
  if (length(prev_months) == 0) {
    prev_month <- max(available_months)  # Wrap around to the last month of the year
  } else {
    prev_month <- max(prev_months)
  }
  
  # Find the nearest following month
  next_months <- available_months[available_months > month]
  if (length(next_months) == 0) {
    next_month <- min(available_months)  # Wrap around to the first month of the year
  } else {
    next_month <- min(next_months)
  }
  
  return(c(prev_month, next_month))
}

# Step 2: For each missing month, select rows from the nearest previous and following months
data_filled <- rbindlist(lapply(1:nrow(missing_data), function(i) {
  zone_name <- missing_data$zone[i]
  missing_months <- missing_data$missing_months[[i]]
  
  # Filter data for the current zone
  zone_data <- data_dt[zone == zone_name]
  
  # For each missing month, select rows from the nearest previous and following months
  rbindlist(lapply(missing_months, function(month) {
    # Find the nearest previous and following months that are not missing
    nearest_months <- find_nearest_months(zone_data, month)
    
    # Select rows from those nearest months
    sampled_data <- zone_data[Month %in% nearest_months]
    
    # Sample with replacement up to 10 rows
    if (nrow(sampled_data) > 0) {
      sampled_data <- sampled_data[sample(.N, size = 10, replace = TRUE)]
    }
    sampled_data[, missing_month := month]  # Add column to indicate the missing month
    sampled_data
  }))
}))

# Step 3: Final data with rows selected for missing months
data_filled

# Combine upsampled data and filled data
final_data <- rbind(upsampled_data, data_filled, fill = TRUE)

# View final data
final_data %>% 
  group_by(zone, Month) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = n) %>% 
  arrange(Month)


```
```{r first boot temporal}
library(data.table)

# Convert the 'Month' column to integers (if necessary)
data_dt[, Month := as.integer(Month)]

# Step 1: Upsample each month within each zone to ensure at least 10 rows
upsampled_data <- data_dt[, {
  if (.N < 10) {
    .SD[sample(.N, size = 10, replace = TRUE)]  # Upsample to 10 rows
  } else {
    .SD  # Keep original data if already 10 or more rows
  }
}, by = .(zone, Month)]

# Step 2: Identify zones with missing months
all_months <- 1:12
missing_data <- upsampled_data[, {
  missing_months <- setdiff(all_months, unique(Month))
  list(missing_months = list(missing_months))
}, by = zone]

# Step 3: Fill missing months by sampling from the same month across all zones
filled_data <- rbindlist(lapply(1:nrow(missing_data), function(i) {
  zone_name <- missing_data$zone[i]
  missing_months <- missing_data$missing_months[[i]]
  
  # For each missing month, sample from the same month across all zones
  rbindlist(lapply(missing_months, function(month) {
    # Find rows from the same month across all zones
    sampled_data <- upsampled_data[Month == month]
    
    # Sample with replacement up to 10 rows
    if (nrow(sampled_data) > 0) {
      sampled_data <- sampled_data[sample(.N, size = 10, replace = TRUE)]
    }
    sampled_data[, missing_month := month]  # Add column to indicate the missing month
    sampled_data[, zone := zone_name]       # Assign the current zone to the sampled rows
    sampled_data
  }))
}))

# Combine upsampled data and filled data
final_data <- rbind(upsampled_data, filled_data, fill = TRUE)

# View final data
print(final_data)
```


```{r define second boot}
# Define the sampling function
generate_sampled_data <- function(data, n_samples) {
  # Group data by Month
  sampled_data <- data[, lapply(.SD, function(col) sample(col, size = n_samples, replace = TRUE)), 
                       by = Month, 
                       .SDcols = c("Apple", "Maize", "Bread")]
  
  # Add sampled ID for identification
  sampled_data[, ID := rep(1:n_samples, times = uniqueN(Month))]
  sampled_data
}

# Repeat the sampling process 10,000 times
n_samples <- length(unique(data$ID)) # 120 unique IDs
n_reps <- 10000

# Use lapply to repeat sampling and calculate means
bootstrap_means <- function(data, n_samples, n_reps) {
  # Perform bootstrap sampling
  sampled_list <- replicate(n_reps, generate_sampled_data(data, n_samples), simplify = FALSE)
  
  # Combine all bootstrap results
  combined_data <- rbindlist(sampled_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE, idcol = "iteration")
  
  # Calculate mean for each month and household across iterations
  summary_data <- combined_data[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = c("Apple", "Maize", "Bread"), by = .(Month, ID)]
  
  return(summary_data)
}

# Generate the final data table
final_data <- bootstrap_means(data_dt, n_samples, n_reps)

# View the final result
print(final_data)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(future.apply)


# Sampling function
generate_sampled_data <- function(data, n_samples) {
  data[, lapply(.SD, function(col) col[sample(.N, size = n_samples, replace = TRUE)]), 
       by = month, .SDcols = food_items][
    , ID := rep(1:n_samples, times = uniqueN(month))]
}

# Bootstrap with parallelization
bootstrap_means <- function(data, n_samples, n_reps, chunk_size = 100) {
  plan(multisession)  # Use multiple cores
  
  # Split iterations into chunks
  chunked_results <- future_lapply(seq(1, n_reps, by = chunk_size), function(start) {
    end <- min(start + chunk_size - 1, n_reps)
    results <- lapply(start:end, function(i) {
      sampled_data <- generate_sampled_data(data, n_samples)
      sampled_data[, lapply(.SD, function(x) base::mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                   .SDcols = food_items, 
                   by = .(month, ID)]
    })
    rbindlist(results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  })
  
  # Combine all chunks
  final_data <- rbindlist(chunked_results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  return(final_data)
}

# Run optimized workflow
# n_samples <- 340
# n_reps <- 10000
```

# New function

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Sampling function
rd <- function(x, size) sample(x, size = size, replace = TRUE)

# 2. Prep function to prepare nested list
prep <- function(df, name = "name") {
  # Filter data for the specified zone
  df_boot <- df[zone == name]
  
  # Remove unnecessary columns and group by month
  df_boot <- df_boot %>%
    select(-c(zone, y4_hhid)) %>%
    group_by(month)
  
  # Split grouped data into a list of data.tables (one per month)
  group_split(df_boot, keep = TRUE)
}

# 3. Specify sample size based on the number of households surveyed
def_n <- function(name = "name") {
  # Return the sample size (assumes `n` is a pre-defined data.frame)
  n %>% 
    filter(zone == name) %>%
    pull(n)
}

# 4. Bootstrap function for a single iteration
bootfun2 <- function(lst, size) {
  # Sample from each month's data
  df_l2 <- lapply(lst, function(df) {
    # Apply sampling to each column
    as.data.table(lapply(df, rd, size = size))
  })
  
  # Combine all month-level samples into one data.table
  dfl <- rbindlist(df_l2, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  # Add month ID and household ID
  dfl[, month := rep(1:length(lst), each = size)]
  dfl[, y4_hhid := rep(1:size, times = length(lst))]
  
  return(dfl)
}

# 5. Workflow to repeat the bootstrap process and calculate mean
bootstrap_workflow <- function(df, zone_name, reps = 10) {
  # Get sample size (N) per month for the specified zone
  N <- def_n(zone_name)
  
  # Prepare nested list by month
  df_list <- prep(df, name = zone_name)
  
  # Perform bootstrap sampling
  boot_list <- replicate(reps, bootfun2(df_list, size = N), simplify = FALSE)
  
  # Combine results from all iterations
  boot_df <- rbindlist(boot_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE, idcol = "iteration")
  
  # Calculate the mean for each month-household combination across iterations
  summary_df <- boot_df[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = names(df)[!names(df) %in% c("month", "y4_hhid")], by = .(month, y4_hhid)]
  
  return(summary_df)
}

# Example Usage
# Assuming `boot_df` is your input data and `n` is a data.frame with zone and sample size info
reps <- 10
zone_name <- "Coastal"
result <- bootstrap_workflow(boot_df, zone_name, reps)

df <- boot_df
#

  # Prepare nested list by month
  df_list <- prep(df, name = zone_name)
  
  # Perform bootstrap sampling

  # Calculate the mean for each month-household combination across iterations
  summary_df <- boot_df[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = names(df)[!names(df) %in% c("month", "y4_hhid")], by = .(month, y4_hhid)]
  
  return(summary_df)
```

```{r}
# 2. Prepare nested list by month for a given zone

  dt <- as.data.table(df)
  dt <- dt[zone == name]
  dt <- dt[, !c("zone", "y4_hhid"), with = FALSE]
  dt <- dt %>% arrange(month)
  split(dt, by = "month", keep.by = FALSE)
}

# 3. Get sample size for zone
def_n <- function(name = "name") {
  # 'n' must be a data.frame or data.table with columns 'zone' and 'n'
  n$n[n$zone == name]
}

# 4. Bootstrap one sample (per repetition)
bootfun2 <- function(lst) {
  sampled_list <- lapply(lst, function(dt) as.data.table(lapply(dt, rd)))
  dfl <- rbindlist(sampled_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE, idcol = "month") # retain month
  dfl[, row_id := rowidv(month)] # add virtual household id
  return(dfl)
}
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(future.apply)

# 1. Sampling function (N = households per month)
rd <- function(x) sample(x, size = N, replace = TRUE)

# 2. Prepare nested list by month (ensure 12 months)
prep <- function(df, name = "name") {
  dt <- as.data.table(df)
  dt <- dt[zone == name]
  dt <- dt[, !c("zone", "y4_hhid"), with = FALSE]
  split_dt <- split(dt, by = "month", keep.by = FALSE)
  
  # Ensure 12 months exist (error if not)
  if (length(split_dt) != 12) {
    stop("Data does not contain all 12 months for zone: ", name)
  }
  
  return(split_dt)
}

# 3. Get sample size per month (modify def_n if needed)
def_n <- function(name = "name") {
  # Replace with logic to get N per month if needed
  # Example: mean(n$n[n$zone == name]) / 12 (if n is annual)
  n$n[n$zone == name]  # Current logic (assumes N is per month)
}

# 4. Bootstrap one sample (per repetition)
bootfun2 <- function(lst) {
  sampled_list <- lapply(lst, function(dt) {
    dt_sampled <- as.data.table(lapply(dt, rd))
    # Add check for N rows
    if (nrow(dt_sampled) != N) {
      warning("Sampled rows (", nrow(dt_sampled), ") != N (", N, ") for a month")
    }
    return(dt_sampled)
  })
  rbindlist(sampled_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

# 5. Clean/aggregate result
bootclean <- function(df) {
  setDT(df)
  df[, lapply(.SD, mn), .SDcols = vars, by = .(month, y4_hhid)]
}

# --- MAIN SCRIPT ---
reps <- 10
zone_name <- "Coastal"

# Prepare data
N <- def_n(zone_name)  # Must return N per month
boot_df <- as.data.table(boot_df)  # Ensure input is data.table
df_list <- prep(boot_df, zone_name)

# Verify df_list has 12 elements (months)
stopifnot(length(df_list) == 12)

# Parallel bootstrap
future::plan(future::multisession)
boot_list <- future_lapply(seq_len(reps), function(i) bootfun2(df_list))

# Verify boot_list elements have N*12 rows (N per month × 12 months)
stopifnot(all(sapply(boot_list, nrow) == N * 12))

# Combine results
boot_coastal <- rbindlist(boot_list, idcol = "replicate")
pc.coastal <- bootclean(boot_coastal)
```
